source_checks.scope: Independent source comparison only; no build/test/browser/live execution.
source_checks.inventory_membership_note: The 15 original inventories plus 2 supplemental domain inventories intentionally reuse 13 existing glossary/helper entries. 469 memberships represent 456 unique authored terms; counts must not be added as unique terms.

findings.title: Form-level click feedback could announce review before validation
findings.impact: The delegated click handler would match the form while clicking its input and announce the target reviewed before required-field validation. The submit handler reads a different attribute.
findings.resolution: Owner changed the form to data-demo-success, retaining required input and safe form normalisation. Exact source re-read.
findings.acceptance: Rendered check should show no review feedback on input focus/click or invalid submission; valid submit should give local-only review feedback without navigation or a device request.

findings.title: Helper definition implied actual creation could not affect automations
findings.impact: Actual helper creation or saved state publication can participate in native automation triggers, so an unconditional no-effect guarantee would be misleading.
findings.resolution: Owner now separates opening/editing a draft from creation/saved state changes and explicitly acknowledges dependent automations. Current source re-read.

findings.title: Domain definition omitted integration and action namespaces
findings.impact: The official glossary covers entity and action prefixes, including provider integration domains. Defining Domain only as an entity-family prefix would be incomplete and confusing in action instructions.
findings.resolution: Owner now explicitly distinguishes light.reading_lamp and hue.activate_scene namespaces and the entity family from the providing integration. Current source re-read.

findings.title: Person summary omitted its away outcome
findings.resolution: Owner expanded the definition to home, away or named-zone state. Exact final field re-read and checked against current official Person guidance.

navigation_and_scope.native_navigation: Current state-object guidance uses Settings > Tools > States, consistent with the exact Tools label in the pinned English frontend. Helpers example is version-qualified. Apps is distinguished from the Companion app and older Add-ons wording.
navigation_and_scope.completeness: 83/83 glossary entries and 45/45 platforms remain matched exactly. Final register contains 456 unique authored entries across 17 inventories, with 469 memberships because supplemental domain inventories reuse 13 existing entries. All 15 additional census domains and 3 separately documented domains map exactly once by domain. The 681 contextual native labels remain explicitly scoped to platform translation subtrees; no claim of all vendors, future strings, installed capabilities or runtime adaptation.
navigation_and_scope.condition_semantics: Current official targets documentation explicitly states that unknown/unavailable targets are ignored for these Any/All target conditions and that All can pass when all targets are missing. The chapter/specimen preserve this rule while refusing to claim physical closure.
navigation_and_scope.licensing: Attribution now explicitly separates original civica explanations from upstream names/labels. Apache licence text is included in the register, and official glossary definitions/artwork are not bundled. This is a source/provenance review, not legal certification.

semantics.notes: Current official Alert guidance and pinned strings agree: off means Acknowledged while the configured condition remains true. No claim that acknowledgement resolves the underlying issue.
Official guidance identifies an internal developer-facing request/callback mechanism. Register does not turn it into the general Settings setup flow or a household device control.
Tracker-derived home, away and named-zone states are explicit. Person is separate from a user account, and no presence/safety verification is inferred.
Astronomical calculation for configured location is distinct from measured light/weather. No room-brightness or equipment behaviour is inferred.
Configured sensor readings and thresholds are distinct from health diagnosis or universal care limits. Native title Plant Monitor matches the pinned source.
